unavailable: The cross-device service is not running.
daemonRestarting: The cross-device service stopped unexpectedly and is restarting.
deviceRenamed: This device is now called {{name}}. Paired devices will see the new name within a few seconds.
noDevices: No paired devices yet. Add one below.
noOnlineDevices: No devices are online right now.
deviceRevoked: Revoked {{name}}. It can no longer reconnect.
pairLinkCopied: Pairing link copied. Send it to the other device and paste it under "Enter the other device's code".
peerCodeLabel: Pairing code from the other device
confirmPairHint: Check that both devices show exactly the same digits and emoji. If they differ, someone may be intercepting the connection — choose "They don't match".
optClipSyncDesc: Send what you copy to your paired devices, and apply what they copy here.
optAutoAcceptDesc: Only applies to long-term devices. Temporary devices always ask.
changeDownloadDirTitle: Choose where received files are saved
downloadDirChanged: Received files will be saved to {{path}}.
clipEchoSkipped: Skipped — this is the content that just arrived from another device.
clipConflictLine: {{device}} and this device copied content at nearly the same time
clipConflictHint: Neither side overwrote the other — both copied before seeing the other's latest content. Whichever arrived later takes effect; to keep the other one, copy it again on that device.
dropToSendSelected: Drop to send to {{count}} selected device(s)
dropToSendAll: Drop to send to all {{count}} online device(s)
nearbyEmpty: Nothing found. Both devices must be on the same network and have Tessera open.
nearbyUnverified: Unverified name — check the security code before confirming
nearbyEmptyHint: Use “Scan the network” to look actively. Some routers drop the multicast packets automatic discovery relies on, and scanning is the only thing that finds devices then.
myAddressUnknown: No address available right now — check the network connection.
firewallBlocked: Windows Firewall is blocking Tessera's cross-device service, so other devices cannot find this computer.
firewallFixed: Allowed. Other devices can find this computer now.
firewallNotGranted: Not authorised — the rule was not added.
diagIdle: If a device will not connect, run this and it will tell you which step is failing.
diag.listening.fail: Not listening — nothing can connect in.
diag.listening.fix: Quit Tessera and open it again. If that does not help, see the diagnostics in Settings.
diag.endpoints.fix: Check that Ethernet or Wi-Fi is connected. A VPN on its own is not enough for local transfers.
diag.mdns_publish.warn: Could not announce on the local network, so other devices will not see you automatically.
diag.mdns_publish.fix: Usually a firewall or router dropping multicast. “Scan the network” and “Enter an address” both work around it.
diag.beacon.warn: Reply port {{port}} is not open, so other devices will not find this computer when they scan.
diag.beacon.fix: Usually another program holds that port, or the firewall is blocking it. Scanning from this computer still works.
diag.mdns_peers.fix: Use “Scan the network” to look actively — that is the only path that works when multicast is dropped.
diag.mdns_peers.info: No other Tessera device is announcing itself on this network right now.
diag.lan_scan.warn: The active scan probed {{probed}} addresses on {{subnets}} and found nothing.
diag.lan_scan.fail: The active scan could not run.
diag.lan_scan.fix: Check that the other device has Tessera open and is on the same Wi-Fi or router as this computer. If it still fails, use “Enter an address”.
diag.lan_scan.info: Scanned {{probed}} addresses ({{subnets}}); no other device is online right now.
pickTargetFirst: Choose which device to send to first
fanoutTickBelow: {{count}} ticked in the device list below
clipSentNowhere: Nothing received it — no device is connected right now
receiptRelayedHint: This one went through the rendezvous server. It only ever sees ciphertext and the file size, never the content: encryption is end-to-end and the server holds no keys.
receiptDirectHint: Sent straight between the two devices. No third-party server was involved.
filesSkipped: {{count}} item(s) could not be sent: {{names}} (empty folder or unreadable)
clipAutoOnDesc: Copy on any device and the others can paste it straight away — no button needed. Only the most recent copy is synced.
clipAutoOffDesc: Right now only the Send clipboard button syncs anything. Turn this on and copying is enough.
shortCodeShowTitle: Show a code on this device
crossnetExplain: You don't need this when both devices are on the same Wi-Fi — they connect directly. It's for when one of them is elsewhere (phone on mobile data, computer at home): they need a meeting point both can reach in order to find each other. Your files stay encrypted throughout; the meeting point only helps them shake hands and never sees any content.
crossnetAddrHelp: Like example.com:47820 or 1.2.3.4:47820. Both devices must use the same one.
crossnetSecretHelp: Fill this in if that server has a password set. A saved password is never shown back.
crossnetMeteredDesc: Relaying sends the whole file over the network, which uses a lot of data. When off, metered networks only get direct connections.
crossnetDisabled: Cross-network turned off — same Wi-Fi only from now on
deviceDetailEmpty: Pick a device on the left to see how it is connected
optClipPlainOnlyDesc: Sync text and images without web/Word rich formatting: faster, and hidden styles or links stay behind.
clipLatencyStats: Last {{n}}: min {{min}} ms · avg {{avg}} ms · max {{max}} ms
clipTimelineEmpty: Nothing yet. Copy something on any device and it shows up here.
clipTimelineSyncOff: Auto sync is off: incoming items are not written to your clipboard, but they still appear here to paste by hand.
clipTimelineOffline: {{device}} is offline and the content has not been fetched yet
clipTimelineHint: Kept in memory only and cleared when the app exits; items marked sensitive by password managers never enter the timeline. When a device connects, the items it copied while offline are fetched.
policyClipHint: This device only. Filtered in both directions by this device's setting: "Text only" neither sends images to it nor accepts its images; "Off" also hides the clipboard timeline from it.
policyFileHint: Overrides the global auto-accept switch: "Always ask" asks even when auto-accept is on; "Auto-accept" accepts even when it is off.
offline.not_found: Not found on the local network, and cross-network is not set up
offline.not_found_crossnet: Seen neither on the local network nor at the rendezvous
offline.metered: Metered network: relay skipped by your setting
offline.refused: Reachable, but Tessera is not running there
offline.timeout: No response; probably not on the same network
offline.auth: Connected but identity check failed; re-pairing may be needed
